name: BioCoder
description: Pre-trained large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved code generation. As these models scale up, there is an increasing need for the output to handle more intricate tasks and to be appropriately specialized to particular domains. Here, we target bioinformatics due to the amount of domain knowledge, algorithms, and data operations this discipline requires.
reputation: A domain-specific code benchmark for bioinformatics that is useful for assessing specialization beyond generic code generation tasks.
notes: Domain-specific and likely smaller than mainstream code benchmarks; results may be sensitive to prompt format and contamination from public bioinformatics code.
